bibl.title: The Encomium of an Official.
bibl.seg: Raffaella Cribiore, The Encomium of an Official.
bibl.note: Fragment of an hexametric text written with ink on plaster, discovered during excavations in Trimithis (Amheida) in 2005 (Inv. 2026). The text (which belongs to the corpus of progymnasmata) is dedicated to Aristonikos, known as βασιλικὸς γραμματεύς. The office disappeared in the middle of the third century CE, the text should be dated before then.
